lessons.t: Kiran comes from Sydney – Present simple
She's got blond hair – have/has got; множествено число; there is/are
I go jogging twice a week – наречия за честота; at
I'm doing my French homework – Present continuous; can
School life in the UK and USA
I'm visiting my friends – Present simple или Present continuous
I hate falling over – глаголи за чувства + -ing
Are there any mushrooms? – броими и неброими; some, any, no
The best thing is the balcony – сравнителна и превъзходна степен
You've got a lot of luggage! – much, many, a lot of, a few, a little; can/could/may
How wide is it? – How + прилагателно за размер; големи числа
Famous monuments in the UK and USA
What was the date? – Past simple на to be; there was/were
A strange thing happened – Past simple – правилни глаголи; a/an, the
I only had a £20 note – Past simple – неправилни глаголи; ago
He was wearing weird clothes – Past continuous; наречия за начин
Whose idea was that? – притежателни местоимения; Whose?; 's и s'
I was cycling when… – Past continuous и Past simple; while/when; предлози за място и движение
When's he arriving? – Present continuous за бъдеще
I'd like a green salad, please – like и would like
Will life be different? – will за предвиждания
I couldn't sleep – could, was/were able to
I'll be more careful – will за решения и обещания; shall
To help the environment – инфинитив за цел
People are so frightened that… – нулев член; so + прилагателно + that
There's too much pollution – too many, too much, not enough; some-/any-/no-/every-
Stella's such a fantastic singer – such (a/an) + прилагателно + съществително
I'm going to record an album – going to
I'm going to apply – going to или will
Which ones are best? – which + one/ones
If my friend has a problem… – нулево условно; възвратни местоимения
She isn't ugly – be like / look like; a bit, quite, very; (not) as…as
